args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The docstring said ROUND_HALF_EVEN but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly
build.

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Switched the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior.

## Verification
CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.
